_readme: Spell frame sequences that were assembled BY HAND and are not reproducible from their source sheet. Re-running tools/slice_spell_sheet.py does not restore these -- only git does. The slicer reads this file and refuses to write over anything named here; HandAssembledArtTests reads the same file and pins every listed sequence by content hash, so a clobber fails the suite whatever caused it. Lives under Assets/ rather than beside the tool because the headless TestRunner mirrors Assets and nothing else, and a register only one side can read is a register the other side cannot enforce.

sequences.golem_boulder: f2==f3 (held peak), f4/f5 are a stepped alpha fade-out, f0 is an intentional blank wind-up frame. Do not regenerate from golem_sheet_attack_rock.png -- the grid does not match and the post-steps are not reproducible here.
